summary:
Updated implementation plan reflecting user revisions:
1. HomeTab.tsx Grid & Responsiveness: On wide screens, lay out cards in a responsive 2 or 3 column grid (profile card, current class, next class, shortcuts). Ensure accurate stats from db.rules and enrollments, and wire up AttendanceHistoryModal and onSelectSchedule.
2. JadwalView Role & Selector: Keep selectors visible for all users instead of hiding them. Sticky-default to the user's authenticated role and ID (Teacher -> teacher schedule, Student -> student class), while allowing schedule selection.
3. RoleRequestsView: Skipped per user instruction.
